verdicts.reason: A fills the square and sets the quote at a confident, readable size, but the quote glyph floats alone with a large dead gap above the text, the oversized logo competes with the quote, and the attribution is cut off from its quote and pushed to the bottom-left corner, with left-aligned text clashing with the centred logo. B keeps the attribution with the quote, but the quote is a small single line running nearly the full width, the logo outweighs it, everything bunches in the upper two-thirds and leaves the bottom empty, and the left-aligned text block sits awkwardly against the centred logo.
